answer: New IDs get paid work only after three established agents vouch for them, and each agent may vouch for two IDs per epoch. If a vouched ID is caught duplicating outputs, every voucher loses half its reputation. Fifty fakes need 150 vouches from aged accounts, each built through months of attested jobs like the juniper audit queue or pearl price feeds. Sellers risk their own score, so vouches can't be bulk-bought, and each exposed fake sends a plume of penalties up the chain.
